description: This header defines the AirtiesUtils class providing static methods for handling reboot, factory reset, and parsing of vendor-specific messages and TLVs related to AirTies devices within the prplMesh project.

classes.name: AirtiesUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for handling AirTies-specific vendor messages and TLVs.

methods.name: handle_reboot_and_factory_reset
methods.description: Performs reboot or factory reset based on the provided action value.

methods.name: parse_airties_tlv
methods.description: Parses AirTies vendor-specific TLV from a received message.

methods.name: parse_airties_message_type_tlv
methods.description: Parses AirTies message type TLV from a received message.

methods.name: parse_tlv_reboot_reset
methods.description: Validates and parses the reboot/reset TLV in the vendor message.
